summaries.summary: A stampede during a Durga Puja celebration in Kolkata has resulted in at least 19 deaths and many injuries. Investigations are ongoing, and several arrests have been made.
Apple is addressing high demand by advising retail staff to warn customers against walk-in purchases of its new iPhone Duo, which has seen preorders sell out quickly.
Meta has updated its terms to remove language that previously raised concerns regarding web scraping and AI training.
Former President Trump has eased oil sanctions against Russia, though questions remain regarding European dependency on Russian gas.
Intel has announced that its upcoming Razor Lake-AX will achieve 700 TOPS in AI performance, significantly exceeding current standards.
The newly launched Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has received overwhelmingly positive reviews on Steam, indicating strong player satisfaction.
Protests in France have escalated into violence, leading to significant arrests and widespread unrest, with President Macron promising to take action.
In Madhya Pradesh, a tragic incident occurred where a truck ran over devotees near a temple, resulting in multiple fatalities and injuries.
Replit has chosen OpenAI as its default model over Anthropic, signaling a strategic shift in its service offerings.
A Delhi court has ordered the release of CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke after he signed a peace bond following his arrest.
In a significant decision, timekeepers have officially cancelled the leap second, opting instead for a leap hour.
Ember has released a new temperature-controlled mug that no longer requires an app to adjust temperature, enhancing user experience.
TikTok has permanently banned an advertising account linked to a documentary about Elon Musk, amidst ongoing controversies surrounding the film.
Every major USB-C cable brand is being ranked to assist consumers in making informed purchasing decisions.
Mark Wahlberg is entering the affordable gym market, aiming to compete with the longevity-startup crowd.
In the UK, protests and counter-protests have erupted regarding the election commission and its leadership.
